subject: general
question: The Artisan Mahakumbh 2024, organised by the Government of India in Mumbai, was held to promote artisans under which of the following schemes?

options.text: USTAAD (Upgrading the Skills and Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts for Development)
Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)

solution:
The correct answer is __**USTAAD (Upgrading the Skills and Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts for Development)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Artisan Mahakumbh 2024 was a significant event organized by the Government of India in Mumbai to promote artisans under the Ustad Scheme. 
 
• The Ustad Scheme, officially known as the "USTTAD" (Upgrading the Skills and Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts for Development) scheme, is an initiative of the Ministry of Minority Affairs. It aims to preserve and promote traditional arts and crafts by providing training and support to master artisans and their apprentices. 
 
• The Artisan Mahakumbh 2024 served as a platform to showcase the skills and creations of artisans trained under the Ustad Scheme. The event provided a valuable opportunity for artisans to connect with potential buyers, market their products, and gain recognition for their craftsmanship. It also helped to raise awareness about the importance of preserving traditional arts and crafts.
 
• During the Mahakumbh, a wide range of traditional crafts were showcased, including textiles, pottery, metalwork, wood carving, and more. The event also featured cultural performances, workshops, and seminars, providing a comprehensive experience of India's rich artistic heritage. 
 
• The Artisan Mahakumbh 2024 was a resounding success, attracting a large number of visitors and generating significant interest in traditional crafts. It played a crucial role in promoting the Ustad Scheme and empowering artisans across the country.
